title: "Data Visualization"

## 📊 The Impact of Automation in Finance

### 📖 The Story Behind the Data

During my time at Temasek Polytechnic, I noticed that preparing financial statements often involved hours of manual data entry. Now, as a Fintech student, I have learned how automation can drastically reduce this time.

This graph visualizes a simulation I conducted to compare the time taken to process **1,000 financial records** manually versus using a Python/R script.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Define the Data
data <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Manual Entry", "Fintech Automation"),
  Time_Minutes = c(300, 5) # 5 hours vs 5 minutes
)

# 2. Create the Graph
ggplot(data, aes(x = Method, y = Time_Minutes, fill = Method)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(Time_Minutes, "mins")), vjust = -0.5, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Efficiency Comparison: Processing 1,000 Records",
    y = "Time Taken (Minutes)",
    x = ""
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3498db", "#e74c3c")) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # This makes the background match your website exactly
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#272b30", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#272b30", color = NA),
    
    # This makes all text white
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 14),
    
    # This cleans up the grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

### 💡 Rationale

**What is visualized?** I visualized the quantitative difference in time efficiency (measured in minutes) between traditional manual methods and modern automated methods.

**Why this visualization?** I chose a **Bar Chart** because the dramatic difference in height between the two bars (300 mins vs 5 mins) effectively highlights the **magnitude of efficiency** gained through Fintech. This visual evidence supports my decision to transition from accountancy to a tech-focused career.
